title: Guard WC settings field bootstrap
description: Frontend admin-ajax requests currently trigger wc-settings-api custom field initialization because Composer files bootstrap runs on broad is_admin() during plugins_loaded. Guard custom field initialization to real WooCommerce settings admin requests and keep field classes autoloaded through Composer.
close_reason: Implemented guarded wp_loaded bootstrap for WooCommerce settings custom fields and verified AJAX/frontend/REST/cron/CLI/WooCommerce-inactive scenarios.
